Name: Scrollable Research Cards
Description:
See every unlock on a crowded research card. Hover over the unlock grid and turn the mouse wheel to browse one row at a time.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Cards with more than 12 unlocks show three rows of four icons in the original card footprint, with a scroll indicator.
[*]Scroll in both the full-size cards and the cards that pop up when you hover at lower zoom. The wheel still zooms the research tree outside the unlock grid.
[*]Keeps Core's unlock order, preview and research-effect icons, localized tooltips, and Codex links.
[*]Cards with 12 or fewer unlocks keep their normal layout.
[/list]

Works with vanilla Stardeus and content mods. No additional mods are required.
